name: Chris Bunton
bio: Chris Bunton is a World Champion Down Syndrome Gymnast. He has competed in four international competition Special Olympics Shanghai 2007 and Athens 2011, Trisome game, Florence 2016 and the Down Syndrome Gymnastics World Championship Bochum Germany 2018 winning a swag of medals including gold each time. He is known for Relic (2020), It's Fine, I'm Fine (2022) and Way Out Assistance (2020).
